pristine.sourcePolicy: Byte-exact upstream typecheck (tsc --noEmit) over vendored src/index.ts + src/index.test.ts. The pinned 0.4.0 suite has no @ts-expect-error groups.

pristineProbes.sourcePolicy: Repo-authored React declaration probes compiled with tsc against the vendored react-alien-signals surface.

adapted.sourcePolicy: One-for-one adapted accepted-call inventory for the upstream typecheck artifact plus supplemental public-api probes after permitted import-root transforms.

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import vendored upstream/src; Octane probes import @octanejs/alien-signals
Upstream typecheck call sites live in src/index.test.ts test bodies; adapted counterparts keep each call in one local helper per upstream scenario so the same accepted calls typecheck under tsrx-tsc
Matching @ts-expect-error and expectType groups must reject or accept the same shapes on both sides

upstreamTypecheck assertion-groups pairs also inventory every accepted public-API call occurrence from the pinned upstream type suite as a multiset; adapted must match one-for-one so dropping a duplicate accepted call while another remains is rejected. String quote style and trailing commas are canonicalized before comparison because they are formatter output, not type surface

notes: Upstream ships an executable typecheck suite via package.json typecheck → tsc --noEmit and the pinned tsconfig (src/index.ts + src/index.test.ts). The pinned 0.4.0 suite has no @ts-expect-error groups, so the adapted upstream-typecheck counterpart pins the full accepted public-API call multiset from that suite and may not add a negative group. Repo-authored public-api probes are a required pristine type lane (audit/type-probes/tsconfig.pristine.json) and are mechanically required to belong to that compiler program; adapted counterparts compile under typetests/tsconfig.adapted.json.
